description: Status, evidence tier, limits (why a tier is capped, e.g. 'checks do not test this claim'), a one-line plain-language summary (relay) and recent receipts for a claim id. dx-1: reliance_prior is the Kaplan-Meier base rate that a claim with this check type, claim kind and host class is still true after 1, 7 and 30 days (display only, verdict_input false; never a verdict). Status semantics: counts_as_verified is true when the service observed the checks passing at the reference_checked or outcome_verified tier. Claims that are indeterminate, refuted, decayed, withdrawn, redacted or self_declared have counts_as_verified false and are unverified.

fresh_within.description: Before a costly or irreversible step that relies on this claim: a freshness window like 15m, 6h or 2d (max 30d). Adds reliance.state fresh|stale|refuted|indeterminate|unverified; a verified claim last checked before the window reads stale (not verified for this decision; recheck first). fw-1

require_genuine_identity.description: gi-2 (opt-in): true to also require that the filer's OIDC identity re-derives as genuine from the ledger. Adds identity_rule {status, met, code?, verified_for_this_read, relay}; with fresh_within, reliance.verified_for_this_read also requires it. Shown, not scored.
